vocab.meaning_vi: mã bộ phận/dự án để ghi nhận chi phí
vocab.example: Please write the correct cost centre so the amount goes to your project.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy ghi đúng mã bộ phận để khoản tiền được tính vào dự án của bạn.

vocab.meaning_vi: hoá đơn giá trị gia tăng

vocab.example_vi: Khách sạn phải gửi hoá đơn giá trị gia tăng, không chỉ là phiếu thanh toán.

vocab.example: The taxi fare from the airport to the office is fully covered.

vocab.meaning_vi: thanh toán dứt điểm một khoản tiền

vocab.meaning_vi: liệt kê chi tiết từng khoản

vocab.meaning_vi: bổ sung thêm tiền tạm ứng
vocab.example: Can you top up my travel advance before the trip next week?
vocab.example_vi: Chị có thể bổ sung thêm tiền tạm ứng công tác trước chuyến đi tuần tới không?

listening.title: Checking an expense claim with the accountant

lines.speaker: Minh (Project Engineer)
lines.text: Hi Hoa, I want to ask about my expense claim from the Da Nang trip.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Accountant)
lines.text: Sure. I received your form, but some items are still missing details.

lines.speaker: Minh (Project Engineer)
lines.text: Which ones? I attached all my receipts and the hotel bill.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Accountant)
lines.text: The hotel is fine, but I need a VAT invoice, not just a payment slip.

lines.speaker: Minh (Project Engineer)
lines.text: I understand. I will email the hotel and ask for it today.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Accountant)
lines.text: Also, please itemise your meals. One big number for four days is not enough.

lines.speaker: Minh (Project Engineer)
lines.text: Okay. What about the taxi fare from the airport to the office?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Accountant)
lines.text: That one is fine. Just write the correct cost centre for your project.

lines.speaker: Minh (Project Engineer)
lines.text: Got it. And the coffee I bought for my friend after dinner?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Accountant)
lines.text: Sorry, personal drinks are non-reimbursable, so please remove that line.

lines.speaker: Minh (Project Engineer)
lines.text: Fair enough. When will I get the reimbursement, and can you top up my advance?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Accountant)
lines.text: We will settle everything with your salary this month if you fix it today.

questions.q: What document does Hoa still need for the hotel?
Why must Minh remove the coffee from his claim?
When will the company pay the money back?
